notes:
A black window on a fresh install is fixed. OPTiC draws its interface with a Microsoft component called WebView2, and some Windows builds - Windows Server, and the trimmed-down editions a lot of rented PCs use - do not have it. When it was missing the window opened completely black with no message at all, which looked like a broken program or a bad licence and was neither. The installer now puts it on for you, and if anything else stops the window drawing, OPTiC says so in plain words instead of showing you a black rectangle. Your bots, your database and your reporting were never affected by this - only the window.
Selecting bots counts what you actually picked. Holding shift to select a run of accounts could report far more than you highlighted - sixteen selected reading as sixty. The selection was following the order accounts are stored in rather than the order they are drawn in, so once you had them arranged under labels the two disagreed and everything in between got swept up. It follows what is on screen now, and the count says how many accounts you have selected rather than how many rows, so a divider caught in the middle no longer adds to it.
Tell Radius Scout who to hunt, from the app. New page under Tools - Scout Targets. Name a player, an alliance or a state and your scouts only go to those; leave it empty and it scouts everyone in range exactly as before. How far it scans, scouts per wave, how many marches, whether it teleports, whether it reports - all of it is set there now instead of being typed into the script in every account window, and a change reaches every bot on that server on its next sweep without relaunching a single one. Picking a state also aims the teleport at it, so a hunt stays in the ground you chose. Supporters only, and the settings inside the script still work if you would rather use those.
